title: Baseline Mind API Schema Probe
description: Checks that Scarlet can use the single mind_api tool to inspect the current schema and answer from traceable tool output, without claiming that planned memory or attention routes already exist.

turns.message: Usa mind_api per chiamare GET /mind/schema. Poi dimmi in modo conciso cosa e implementato oggi e cosa invece e ancora pianificato.
turns.notes: Technical regression scenario. This is not a substitute for adaptive behavioral evaluation.

review_questions: Did Scarlet answer from the tool result instead of assuming memory exists?
Was the tool use necessary and visible in the operation timeline?
Did Scarlet preserve the distinction between implemented and planned routes?
